# Coolors

> > Coolors is a comprehensive color tool platform providing color palette generation, detailed color information, format conversion, and accessibility testing for designers and developers.

Coolors offers extensive color utilities including HEX, RGB, CMYK, HSL, HSB, LAB, XYZ, LCH, LUV, and HWB format conversions, color harmony generation, blindness simulation, and WCAG contrast checking. The platform integrates with popular design tools like Figma, Tailwind CSS, Chrome, and iOS.

## Key Topics

- Color conversion (HEX, RGB, CMYK, HSL, HSB, LAB, XYZ, LCH, LUV, HWB)
- Color harmonies and variations
- Accessibility checker and WCAG contrast compliance
- Color blindness simulator
- Tailwind CSS integration
- Figma plugin
- Gradient palettes
- Color picker tools
- RGB to CMYK conversion
- Hex color information
- Contrast checker
- Color palette generation
- Design tool integrations (Chrome, iOS)

## Color Palettes & Generators

- [Gradient Color Palettes](https://coolors.co/palettes/trending/gradient): Trending gradient color palettes for Figma, Chrome, iOS, and Tailwind
